# Motors Public API


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## Overview

Re-exports the full public API for `emachines.motors`.

Importing from `emachines.motors` gives access to all public symbols
without needing to know which submodule they live in.

## Usage

``` python
from emachines.motors import *
# or selectively:
from emachines.motors import GeometricParams
from emachines.motors import PMSMParams
```
